app_identity.name: Amo Pay
app_identity.purpose: Isanduku y'ifaranga ryuzuye n'serivisi z'imari zigamije kohereza amafaranga, guhindura ifaranga, n'serivisi z'ubucuruzi.

features.name: Ohereza Amafaranga
features.description: Ohereza amafaranga mu Rwanda ukoresheje Mobile Money cyangwa Banki. Igiciro kirafungwa kugira ngo kidahinduka.

features.name: Ishyura Fagitire
features.description: Ishyura fagitire nk'umuriro (REG), amazi (WASAC), unit (MTN, Airtel), Irembo, na Televiziyo.

features.name: Kugura Unit
features.description: Shyiramo unit kuri telefone iyo ari yo yose vuba.

features.name: Guhindura Ifaranga
features.description: Hindura amafaranga hagati ya RWF, USD, EUR, GBP, na PLN.

features.name: Kugenzura Indangamuntu (KYC)
features.process: Ni ngombwa kugira ngo wohereze amafaranga. Bisaba amasaha 24-48.

features.name: Isomero rya Marchande
features.description: Igikoresho cy'abacuruzi gisoma kode za QR z'abakiriya.
features.access: Biboneka kuri telefone gusa muri menu y'abacuruzi.

features.name: Kode QR y'Umucuruzi
features.description: Kode ya QR ihariye umucuruzi akoresha akira ubwishyu.

features.name: Translator / Umuhinduzi
features.description: Igikoresho cya AI cyandura amagambo n'interuro.

features.name: Referrals / Shishikariza Abandi
features.access: Ibi biraboneka gusa kuri verisiyo ya interineti kuri amopay.com.

features.name: Developer Docs / API
features.access: Ibi biraboneka gusa kuri verisiyo ya interineti.

features.name: Kugenzura mu Mubiri (Biometrics)
features.description: Injira ukoresheje Face ID cyangwa Igikumwe.

rules.max_transfer_rwf: Umupaka ntarengwa ni 5,000,000 RWF ku nshuro imwe.
rules.rate_lock_mobile_s: Igiciro kirafungwa mu gihe cy'amasegonda 300 (iminota 5) kuri telefone.
rules.rate_lock_web_m: Igiciro kirafungwa mu gihe cy'iminota 15 kuri web.
rules.password: Ijambo ry'ibanga rigomba kuba rifite inyuguti 8-128, inyuguti nkuru, nto, umubare, n'akamenyetso.
rules.phone_rw: Numero ya telefone igomba kuba itangira na +250 7[2,3,8,9]... (imibare 9 nyuma ya +250)

messages.web_only: Ibi biraboneka gusa kuri verisiyo ya interineti kuri amopay.com.
messages.mobile_only: Ibi biraboneka gusa kuri porogaramu ya telefone (mobile app).
messages.contact_support: Wasiliana natwe kuri support@amopay.com cyangwa hamagara +250 700 000 000.
messages.no_info: Ntabwo mfite ibyo makuru ubu. Mwaduhamagara kuri support@amopay.com kugira ngo mubone ubufasha.

error_messages.rate_expired: Igiciro cyarangiye. Vugurura kugira ngo ubone igiciro gishya.
